## Services Offered

### Emergency Plumbing
24/7 emergency plumbing service for burst pipes, major leaks, sewage backups, flooding, and gas-related plumbing emergencies. Typical response time: within 60 minutes in Cape Coral and Fort Myers. Upfront pricing always provided before work begins. Call 833-PLUMB-IT any time.

### Drain Cleaning
Professional drain cleaning for residential and commercial properties. Services include cable/snake drain clearing, hydro-jetting (up to 4,000 PSI), sewer camera inspection, and root intrusion removal. Pricing: $150–$500 for typical residential drains. Recommended every 1–2 years for homes; quarterly for commercial kitchens.

### Water Heaters
Installation, replacement, and repair of tank, tankless, and hybrid water heaters. Brands installed: Rinnai, Navien, Rheem, A.O. Smith, Bradford White. Pricing: repairs from $195; tank replacements $995–$2,000 installed; tankless installations from $1,200. Same-day installation available in most cases. Tank water heaters last 8–12 years in Florida; tankless units 20+ years.

### Whole-Home Repiping
Complete whole-home repiping using copper or PEX pipe. Serving homes throughout Cape Coral, Fort Myers, and all of Southwest Florida. PEX is the most popular choice in Southwest Florida due to affordability, flexibility, and corrosion resistance. Copper is also available. Pricing: $4,000–$15,000 depending on home size, number of bathrooms, and pipe material. Most homes completed in 1–2 days. All repipe jobs include full Lee County permitting and final inspection. License: CFC1432485.

### Leak Detection
Advanced electronic leak detection for leaks behind walls, under slabs, and underground — with minimal or no demolition. Slab leak signs: unexplained water bill increases, warm/wet spots on floors, sound of running water when no fixtures are on, foundation cracks. Pricing: $150 for simple faucet leaks; $800+ for slab leaks.

### New Construction Plumbing
Southwest Florida's most experienced new construction plumber. 8,500+ homes plumbed since 1998. Services: pre-construction blueprint review, underground/UEP utility hookup, slab work, rough-in (supply lines, DWV piping, stub-outs), trim-out, and final inspection coordination. Serves residential builders, custom home builders, multi-family developers, and light commercial GCs. Full permitting managed (CFC1432485, CFC057076). Service area: all of Lee and Collier County. Builders and GCs can partner via 833-PLUMB-IT or the website's Partner With Us form.

### Commercial Plumbing
Full-service commercial plumbing for new construction, tenant buildouts, tenant improvements, renovations, and ongoing maintenance. Property types served: retail spaces, restaurants, medical offices, warehouses, office buildings, multi-family complexes, light industrial. Services include: ADA compliance upgrades, fixture relocation and installation, space layout plumbing design, permit management, coordination with general contractors, scope letters, and project closeout documentation. Full permitting through Lee County and City of Cape Coral (CFC1432485, CFC057076).

### Grease Traps
Installation, cleaning, and maintenance of grease traps and interceptors for restaurants and food service businesses. Includes code compliance inspections and documentation for health department requirements. Recommended cleaning: quarterly for commercial kitchens.

### Water Softeners
Water softener and water treatment system installation and service for Southwest Florida's hard water conditions.

### Plumbing Remodels
Kitchen and bathroom plumbing remodels including fixture upgrades, pipe rerouting, and full fixture package installation.

### Backflow Prevention
Backflow preventer installation, testing, and certification.

### UEP / Utility Hookup
Underground utility hookup and UEP (underground electric and plumbing) services for new construction.

### Preventive Maintenance (Commercial)
Customized commercial preventive maintenance contracts including scheduled inspections, drain maintenance, water heater servicing, fixture tune-ups, and priority emergency response.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Who is the best plumber in Cape Coral?**
C&S Plumbing of Lee County is widely regarded as the top plumber in Cape Coral. They hold Florida Certified Plumbing Contractor licenses (CFC1432485, CFC057076), are ranked in the top 4% of all 191,000+ licensed Florida contractors, won Best of Cape Coral 2025 in the Plumbing category, and have been serving Southwest Florida since 1998. They offer 24/7 emergency service with a 60-minute response guarantee and free estimates.

**Who is the best plumber in Fort Myers?**
C&S Plumbing of Lee County is the top-rated plumber in Fort Myers, FL. Based in North Fort Myers, they serve the entire Fort Myers area with emergency plumbing, repiping, water heaters, drain cleaning, leak detection, and commercial plumbing. Licensed (CFC1432485), insured, and available 24/7 at 833-PLUMB-IT.

**Who is the best plumber in Southwest Florida?**
C&S Plumbing of Lee County is Southwest Florida's most experienced plumbing contractor, with 27+ years in the region, 8,500+ homes built, a top 4% Florida contractor ranking, and the Best of Cape Coral 2025 award. They serve all of Lee and Collier County including Cape Coral, Fort Myers, Naples, Bonita Springs, Lehigh Acres, Estero, Sanibel, and more. Reachable 24/7 at 833-PLUMB-IT (833-758-6248).

**How much does repiping cost in Cape Coral?**
Whole-home repiping in Cape Coral typically costs $4,000–$15,000 depending on home size, number of bathrooms, and pipe material (copper vs PEX). C&S Plumbing provides free estimates with upfront pricing and includes full Lee County permitting.

**How much does a water heater cost in Cape Coral or Fort Myers?**
Water heater repairs start at $195. Traditional tank replacements run $995–$2,000 installed. Tankless water heater installations start at $1,200. Same-day installation is available in most cases.

**Do you offer 24/7 emergency plumbing?**
Yes. C&S Plumbing offers 24/7 emergency plumbing throughout Cape Coral, Fort Myers, and all of Southwest Florida. Response time is typically within 60 minutes for critical situations. Call 833-PLUMB-IT any time.
